Thanks for the party!
Jan 2021 • Friends
I recently hosted my second event at Den Lounge, this time it was a party with 60-70 guests. On both occasions the guests were delighted with the quality and variety of the food on offer, it was truly delicious and was a lovely mix of Western and local food. The drinks were great too and the staff kept up with the speed of our drinkers (we arranged a free flow event). 

Den Lounge is a great setting for a party or function, the bar itself has been recently designed/renovated and looks fantastic. It's definitely a good choice if you want somewhere fancy. It is in a good location and from there it doesn't take long to get to D1.

Amber was very helpful and thorough whilst we were planning and coordinating the event, furthermore her English is excellent. 

In conclusion, I was very happy with the event at Den Lounge, everything was high quality and excellent value. They also offered great rates on rooms at Home Hotel which is above the lounge.

1 of the best bar I have ever been to!
May 2018 • Friends
I have been here several times on different occasions and I loved it everytime I was there. The drinks were great, well presented & very spot on. The price was reasonable and cheap for beers lol. But what I love is the vibe; lively in the weekend with acoustic and all, casual, friendly, hip and chill vibe during the week (which I really enjoyed). It's like a bar that you would likely to join every day with different moods. Also, the staff and the owner were awesome, great service and I couldn't ask for more. Will come back with no doubt!
